research_question: What is the effect of immune checkpoint inhibitors plus platinum-based chemotherapy, compared with chemotherapy alone (with or without placebo), on overall survival at any time point in patients aged 65 years and older?
treatment_label: Immune checkpoint inhibitor plus platinum-based chemotherapy
control_label: Platinum-based chemotherapy alone (with or without placebo)
outcome_description: Overall survival (OS) in participants aged 65 years and older, expressed as a hazard ratio (HR) with 95% confidence intervals or log(HR) with standard error
positive_direction: A positive effect indicates improved overall survival favoring immune checkpoint inhibitors plus platinum-based chemotherapy over chemotherapy alone
search_queries: immune checkpoint inhibitor platinum chemotherapy elderly randomized trial
immunotherapy platinum doublet overall survival aged 65 trial
PD 1 PD L1 platinum chemotherapy older adults trial
inclusion_criteria: Controlled clinical trials comparing immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) combined with platinum-based chemotherapy versus platinum-based chemotherapy alone (with or without placebo)
Studies reporting overall survival (OS) data specifically for adult participants aged 65 years and older
Quantitative outcome reporting from which a hazard ratio and measure of variance (e.g., 95% CI or SE) can be extracted or derived
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, review articles, editorials, commentaries, and theoretical papers are excluded)
No comparison between an immune checkpoint inhibitor plus platinum chemotherapy arm and a platinum chemotherapy alone control arm
No quantitative outcome data that can produce an effect size (lacking hazard ratios, 95% confidence intervals, or extractable survival data)
Completely unrelated to the research topic or studies without separate subgroup data for patients aged 65 years and older
moderators_to_extract: Cancer type and histology (e.g., non-small cell lung cancer, extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, urothelial carcinoma)
Specific ICI class and agent (e.g., anti-PD-1 vs anti-PD-L1 vs anti-CTLA-4)
Line of therapy (e.g., first-line vs second-line or maintenance)
effect_size_note: Extract the Hazard Ratio (HR) and 95% confidence interval (or log[HR] and standard error) directly from each trial's subgroup survival analysis for patients aged 65 years and older.
